info.name: SitesForStudios API
info.description:
Backend for SitesForStudios (wedding studio websites + client photo delivery).

Auth is a cookie session: run a "Log in as …" request first; Postman keeps the cookie. Each folder starts with the login for its role.

Requests save ids they return (studioId, eventId, photoId, accountId, clusterId…) into collection variables, so run folders top to bottom.

Pick the "SitesForStudios Local" environment for http://localhost:4000 (demo data from `npm run seed -- --demo`).

item.name: 0. Health & Auth
item.description: Health check and session endpoints shared by every role. Users cannot sign up and there is no forgot-password endpoint: studios create accounts and reset passwords.

request.description: Returns {"ok":true} when the API and PostgreSQL are reachable.
Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Super Admin.
Current user (null when logged out), with org, plan and studio names.

Any logged-in user. Logs out other devices (token_version is bumped) and keeps this session. As shipped, newPassword equals the current one, so the API answers 400 and nothing changes (safe in collection runs). Put a real new password in the body to change it.
Clears the session cookie.

item.name: 1. Super Admin
item.description: Role: super_admin. Platform overview, plans and organizations.

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Super Admin.
Counts of organizations, studios, events, storage, enquiries (30 days) and MRR in INR.
Starter, Pro, Organization with limits and prices.
Edit a plan. `razorpay_plan_id` links it to a Razorpay plan for subscriptions.
All organizations with plan, owner email, studio count and storage used. Saves the first id as {{orgId}}.
Creates the organization and its owner login. The response contains a one-time temporary password for the owner. Saves {{newOrgId}}.
Change plan, status (trial, active, past_due, suspended, cancelled) or name.

item.name: 2. Organization
item.description: Role: org_admin (super_admin can also call these with ?orgId=). The paying customer: plan, usage and studios.

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Organization owner.
Plan limits and current storage/events usage.
Studios (partners) in this organization with event and new-enquiry counts. Saves {{studioId}} and {{slug}}.
Creates a studio (fails with 402 when the plan limit is reached). Optionally creates a studio_admin login and returns its temporary password. templateId: editorial | luxe | cinematic (premium).

item.name: 3. Studio - Website & Domain
item.description: Roles: studio_admin, staff (and org_admin / super_admin for their studios).

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Studio admin.
Studios this user can manage. Saves {{studioId}} and {{slug}}.
Website templates with tier (standard / premium).
Site config (theme, sections, packages, testimonials, FAQ, contact, SEO) and highlight photos that can be used as hero images.
All fields are optional; send only what changes. `publish: true` makes the website live. Premium templates need the Pro plan (402).
Returns a signed URL. PUT the image to {{uploadUrl}} (see "Upload file to signed URL" in folder 5), then save `logoKey` with Update website settings.

exec: const u = r.upload.url; pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadUrl', u.startsWith('/') ? pm.variables.get('origin') + u : u);

request.description: Returns the CNAME and TXT records the studio must add at its registrar. Send {"domain": null} to remove.
Checks the CNAME and TXT records now. Status becomes verified when both are found.

item.name: 4. Studio - Clients, Team & Enquiries
item.description: Studios create client and staff accounts (no public sign-up) and manage website enquiries.

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Studio admin.
Saves an event id as {{eventId}} for the client assignment below.
role=client (default) or role=staff. Includes the events each account can see.
accessLevel: primary (the couple: everything incl. RAW) or guest. Returns a one-time temporary password; the client must change it at first login. Saves {{accountId}}.
Studio admins only. Limited by plan staff seats (402).
Replaces the list of events this client can see.
Issues a new temporary password and logs the user out everywhere. This replaces "forgot password".
Enquiries from the website form, newest first. Saves {{enquiryId}}.
new | contacted | quoted | booked | lost

item.name: 5. Studio - Events & Photos
item.description: Upload flow: (1) request signed upload URLs, (2) PUT each file to its URL, (3) call uploads/complete. Processing makes thumbnails and indexes faces.

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Studio admin.
rawEnabled needs the Pro plan (402). Saves {{eventId}}.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Anu & Vivek",
  "eventDate": "2026-12-20",
  "venue": "Bolgatty Palace, Kochi",
  "rawEnabled": true,
  "faceEnabled": true,
  "showInPortfolio": false
}

request.description: Event with photo counts, ceremonies and clients.
Any of: title, eventDate, venue, rawEnabled, faceEnabled, showInPortfolio, coverPhotoId.
Up to 200 files per call. RAW files (.cr3, .nef, .arw, .dng…) need rawEnabled on the event. Checks the organization storage quota (402). Saves {{photoId}} and {{uploadUrl}} for the first file.

exec: const u = f.upload.url; pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadUrl', u.startsWith('/') ? pm.variables.get('origin') + u : u);

request.description: Choose a JPEG under Body → binary before sending. In local dev this goes to the API (/api/uploads/...); in production it goes straight to S3. With S3 + RAW/originals, also send the x-amz-tagging header returned in step 1.
Queues processing for files that finished uploading. Files never uploaded are ignored.
kind=image|raw, optional ceremony and highlights=1. Each photo has signed thumb and web URLs.
Deletes files from storage and their face data.
Studio admins only. Deletes all photos, RAW files and face data of the event.

item.name: 6. Client Portal
item.description: Role: client (studio managers can also open their own events). Clients only see events assigned to them.

request.description: Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Client (couple).
Events with cover image and photo count. Saves {{portalEventId}}.
Ceremonies, highlight count, RAW availability (couple only) and whether face search is on.
Empty unless FACE_PROVIDER=rekognition and photos were indexed. Saves {{clusterId}}.
Returns a 200×200 WebP face crop.
Marks this person as the same as {{otherClusterId}}.
Choose a selfie under Body → binary. Returns the photos the person appears in. The selfie is not stored. Needs face recognition (400 otherwise).
Redirects to a 15-minute signed URL for the original file. In Postman, turn off "Automatically follow redirects" to see the URL.
type = all | highlights | ceremony (with ceremony=) | selected (with ids=comma,separated) | raw (couple only, RAW delivery on). Streams a ZIP; use "Send and Download".

item.name: 7. Public (no login)
item.description: Studio websites and the enquiry form.

request.description: Everything a template needs: studio, template id, site settings, hero images and portfolio.
Used when the app is opened on a studio domain. 404 until the domain is verified.
Rate limited to 10 per hour per IP. Response says whether the date is free (dateAvailable).

item.name: 8. Billing (Razorpay)
item.description: Needs RAZORPAY_* settings on the server.

request.description: Whether billing is enabled and the public key id for Razorpay Checkout.
Logs in and stores the session cookie (sfs_session) in Postman's cookie jar. Every following request in this folder runs as the Organization owner.
Role: org_admin. Creates a Razorpay subscription for the plan. 503 until Razorpay keys are set.
Called by Razorpay. Requires an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body with RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET; without it the API answers 400.

exec: pm.test('400 without a valid signature', () => pm.expect([200, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code));
